title: Vafa-Witten invariants from wall-crossing for framed sheaves
summary: We consider the refined $\mathrm{SU}(r)$ Vafa-Witten partition function of a smooth projective surface with non-zero holomorphic 2-form. This partition function has a vertical contribution, expressible in terms of nested Hilbert schemes. First, we write the vertical contribution in terms of $χ_y$-genera of moduli spaces of framed sheaves on ${\mathbb P}^2$. Then, we state two wall-crossing identities for moduli spaces of framed sheaves: a blow-up formula due to Kuhn-Leigh-Tanaka and a new stable/co-stable wall-crossing formula.
